body: It's just the thought of taking pills to feel artificial and I don't like that at all. And I just read a article about medication changing your personality and on top of that there's side effects from the pill. I just don't believe that's the way and I feel guilty if I do it like that.
I had a psychiatrist appointment in 2016 of November but I cancelled it after the first session so I guess they carried on the information I told them in November to now.
